summary: Editable practice decks can live outside Documents: the game honors L5R_DECKS_DIR, and tools/env.sh sets it to .l5r-local/Decks when a checkout has that git-excluded folder. Default behaviour (Documents\L5R Emperor\Decks) is unchanged for players.
validation: Client builds and Refresh smoke check passed; with the launcher environment the game wrote a missing deck into .l5r-local/Decks and nothing into OneDrive; an explicit L5R_DECKS_DIR creates its folder; 15 decks copied and hash-verified before the OneDrive copy was removed. No automated test: it needs a running Godot.
remaining: None for this change. Legacy checkouts under the OneDrive Desktop\Claude folder still hold unfinished work and were not deleted (needs the owner's decision).
